## Review checklist

- [ ] The changes satisfy the linked issue's acceptance criteria.
- [ ] The scope is focused; unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] Testing steps and actual results are recorded, including any limitations.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots and responsive/accessibility checks, or N/A is explained.
- [ ] Architecture/design changes have updated diagrams and documentation, or N/A is explained.
- [ ] No secrets, generated artifacts, or accidental dependency changes are included.
- [ ] Linked issues have appropriate labels, a sprint milestone, and a responsible assignee.
- [ ] Required checks pass and at least one teammate review is obtained before merge.
